verdicts.label: likely-bug
verdicts.rationale: Adding __slots__ to Marker changes its pickle representation. Objects pickled by the old version (without __slots__) cannot be unpickled by the new version, raising AttributeError. The PR is a performance refactor with no mention of pickling, tests, or changelog updates, so this regression is unintended.
verdicts.facts: An object built by base from ["\"b\" > \"a\""], pickled, then unpickled by head fails to load: builtins.AttributeError.
